title: Zenica miners’ initial production stoppage / work disobedience
reason: Workplace production stoppage; no public assembly or 50-person simultaneous crowd is established.
notes: RSE dates production stopping in Zenica to February 8. Do not assign this as the start of the separate February 15 Breza residents’ assembly.

title: Zenica miners’ general strike
reason: Documented workplace strike; no public gathering or turnout is established for this action.
notes: RSE and Al Jazeera date Zenica’s general strike to February 12. Keep it separate from the initial February 8 production stoppage and the Breza residents’ February 15 assembly.

title: Breza miners’ general strike
reason: Documented workplace strike; no public gathering or turnout is established for this action.
notes: RSE and Al Jazeera date the Breza general strike to February 12. The public gathering documented at the mine is separately dated February 15.

title: One-hour warning strikes at five other Elektroprivreda BiH mines
reason: Solidarity work stoppages; sources do not document a public assembly or attendance.
notes: Keep these five one-hour actions separate from the Zenica and Breza general strikes; no mine-by-mine attendance or public gathering is established.

title: Conditional miners’ protest planned outside the Federation Government in Sarajevo
reason: Conditional announcement; execution of this particular rally is unverified.
notes: The announcement depended on whether the miners’ account dispute was resolved. A same-day agreement does not prove cancellation, and a separate Breza public assembly does not prove that the planned Sarajevo gathering occurred.

title: APF warning strike, reported on its fifth day on February 15
reason: Workplace warning strike; no evidence of a 50-person public assembly is established by the work-action reports.
notes: Federalna says the warning strike was on day five and was expected to continue for 30 days; exact strike onset and actual duration are not established. This is separate from the February 15 gathering outside the Federation Government.
